long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as a chartered accountant and holding a law degree from the University of Dundee, Alexander Donald Mackenzie worked at 3i before joining Citicorp's European venture-capital operation. In 1993 he and colleagues completed the management spinout that created independent CVC Capital Partners. Mackenzie became one of its senior dealmakers, chaired investment committees and later served as co-chair, building both the firm's private-equity franchise and his founder interest in the management business.

CVC's public listing in 2024 made that ownership directly visible through a substantial indirect voting stake. The shares represent an interest in the listed manager; CVC's assets under management are principally client capital, while portfolio companies are owned through funds rather than personally by Mackenzie. He stepped back from active duties before the listing. He remains an honorary co-chair and substantial shareholder, without current executive authority over the firm or personal ownership of its managed assets.
